title: Trump plan taps US firms to fight foreign cybercrime
summary: Trump signed a memorandum allowing vetted private U.S. companies to conduct cyber operations against foreign criminal organizations under oversight.

title: The Will of 100: Trump’s SAVE America Act sidelined after Senate unanimously agreed to August exit
summary: John Thune used unanimous consent to recess the Senate for five weeks, but all 100 senators agreed to leave without debating the SAVE America Act.

title: Trump to honor Artemis II astronauts who traveled farther from Earth than any humans in history
summary: President Donald Trump will award the Congressional Space Medal of Honor to the Artemis II crew at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston on Aug. 28.

title: Trump fires back after protester interrupts Myrtle Beach rally for Graham: 'Mom is voting for us'
summary: Trump fired back at a protester who interrupted his South Carolina rally, quipping that the heckler's mom is voting for him while showing support for Sen. Darline Graham.

title: Trump-appointed judge blocks blue state's crackdown on ICE detention center
summary: A federal judge blocked Colorado's unannounced inspection mandate targeting GEO Group's Aurora ICE detention center, citing the supremacy clause.

title: Supreme Court allows Trump’s White House ballroom construction to continue for now
summary: Chief Justice John Roberts issued a stay allowing above-ground White House ballroom construction to continue as the Supreme Court weighs the case.

title: Bear crashes couple's anniversary getaway, rummages through Tennessee tea shop before jumping on counter
summary: Video captures a black bear jumping onto the counter of a Gatlinburg tea shop while a couple visiting the town for their anniversary trip stood feet away.

title: Caitlin Clark, Aliyah Boston and Kelsey Mitchell combine for big nights as Fever fall short against Liberty
summary: Breanna Stewart scored 22 points and Leonie Fiebich added 20 in her return as the New York Liberty held off the Indiana Fever 109-102 Saturday.

title: Police make arrest after gunfire during California high school football game leaves 1 dead
summary: A 15-year-old was arrested on suspicion of murder and gang participation after a 17-year-old was fatally shot at a Bakersfield, California stadium.

title: Bandido, Athena put on a show at Ring of Honor's Death Before Dishonor in Philadelphia
summary: ROH Death Before Dishonor delivered two title changes and brutal matches at Philadelphia's 2300 Arena as Athena's historic reign hit 1,350 days.
